text:
Silver Price in 2006
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2006, the LBMA silver price rose 30.2% between 2006-01-31 ($9.91) and 2006-12-29 ($12.90). The highest sampled price was $13.68 in November and the lowest was $9.70 in February. The mean of these observations was $11.83. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
